what: Revvity makes life science tools and diagnostics. It supplies reagents and instruments for laboratory research, and runs newborn screening and genetic testing businesses used by health systems worldwide.
customers: Pharmaceutical and biotechnology research laboratories, academic institutions, and hospitals running newborn and genetic screening.
money: reagents, instruments and software for research
newborn screening, immunodiagnostics and applied genomics
moat: Newborn screening programmes run under government contracts in many countries, where its instruments and reagents are the installed standard.
risks: Pharmaceutical research spending has been weak for two years
Revenue has fallen about 5% a year over three years after divestitures
Chinese demand for laboratory equipment has been weak
opportunities: Revenue grew about 4% last year as the research market stabilised
Newborn screening revenue is contracted and recurs regardless of research budgets
Recurring reagents and consumables are the majority of revenue
watch: Organic revenue growth and demand from pharmaceutical customers.
